name: elpi-tools
description: Debugging of standalone Elpi programs (elpi-debug, through the debug adapter elpi-dap)

program.description: The Elpi file of the program.

goal.description: The goal to run, as for elpi-debug (e.g. main, or append [1] [2] L).

args.description: More options of elpi-debug, e.g. ["-I", "dir"] or ["-all"].

stopOnEntry.description: Stop before the first event of the run.

elpiDebug.description: The path of elpi-debug (default: the setting elpiTools.elpiDebugPath, else next to elpi-dap).

configurationSnippets.label: Elpi: debug a goal
configurationSnippets.description: Run a goal of an Elpi file under elpi-debug

elpiTools.adapterPath.description: The path of elpi-dap. Empty: the one built next to this extension (../../_build/install/default/bin/elpi-dap), else elpi-dap from the PATH.

elpiTools.elpiDebugPath.description: The path of elpi-debug. Empty: the one next to elpi-dap.
